about: A line is read by the place its scope's first step names, or the one place its needs lie in but bound; by every place when an own lock speaks it, when it is the published place bound is measured over, when publish/takes carries it into every place, when it is a view, or when its needs are bound's own modules; by the one place a later step of its scope names; and otherwise by the root alone, where the places join. A batch of lines only the root reads touches no place: the act holds the root, and no place's key moves.

cases.name: every place's written views rendered without the lines only the root reads, against the whole tree, on a copy at epoch 264

red was: 514 root lines in every place's key
